title: Reading lab: John 15:1–8
subtitle: Follow a sustained image and its repeated vocabulary.
overview: This paragraph trains sustained reading: repeated μένω, καρπός, and ἐν link its claims across several verses.
Build a word-repetition map alongside your clause map. Repetition is evidence for paragraph structure, not decoration.

items.grc: μείνατε ἐν ἐμοί, κἀγὼ ἐν ὑμῖν.
items.en: Remain in me, and I in you.

items.grc: ἐν τούτῳ ἐδοξάσθη ὁ πατήρ μου, ἵνα καρπὸν πολὺν φέρητε καὶ γένησθε ἐμοὶ μαθηταί.
items.en: In this my Father was glorified: that you bear much fruit and become my disciples.
